# FederationBank v0.5 compatibility validation — v0.2

Input:
  user-supplied federationbank_ssc_snapshot_pre_fees_v0.5.zip
  accepted baseline: FederationBankEngine / MAIN / sourceLevel 5
  repository originally written by semantic source control v0.1

v0.2 loaded the immutable v0.1 snapshot and re-indexed its preserved historical
source blobs in memory using the current semantic analyzer.

Derived v0.2 view of the accepted level-5 source:
  retained v0.1 source blobs: 35
  package entities reconstructed: 35
  classes: 51
  methods: 305
  message-use evidence: 5,134
  accepted independently tracked SQL operations restored: 18

The exact sealed FederationBank v0.5 carrier was then analyzed using v0.2:
  complete release files observed: 45
  packages: 35
  classes: 51
  methods: 305
  message-use evidence: 5,134
  independently tracked SQL operations: 18

Semantic comparison of the re-indexed historical level 5 against the exact same
sealed v0.5 source produced:
  DELTAS = 0

This proves that the v0.2 analyzer upgrade does not manufacture package/method
changes when FederationBank moves from its v0.1 repository into the level-6 fee
impact round. The old accepted source bytes/source level were not rewritten.

Measured on this debug host:
  legacy level-5 semantic re-index/load: ~10.6 s
  full sealed v0.5 current scan:          ~10.6 s
